story.text: 이기대 해안 산책로, 파도 소리만 들리는 벤치에 나란히 앉았다. 아까부터 말수가 줄어든 나를 선우가 가만히 지켜본다.
story.reading: i-gi-dae hae-an san-chaek-lo, pa-do so-ri-man deul-li-neun ben-chi-e na-ran-hi anj-at-da. a-kka-bu-teo mal-su-ga jul-eo-deun na-reul seon-u-ga ga-man-hi ji-kyeo-bon-da.
story.en: On the Igidae coastal trail, we sit side by side on a bench where only the sound of waves can be heard. Sunwoo has been quietly watching me, since I've been unusually quiet for a while now.

story.text: "니 아까부터 표정이 안 좋다. 무슨 일 있제?" 그는 캐묻지 않고, 그저 옆에서 기다려 주는 눈빛으로 묻는다.
story.reading: ni a-kka-bu-teo pyo-jeong-i an jo-ta. mu-seun il it-je? geu-neun kae-mut-ji anh-go, geu-jeo yeop-e-seo gi-da-ryeo ju-neun nun-bit-eu-ro mun-neun-da.
story.en: "You've had a bad look on your face for a while. Something's up, right?" He doesn't press, just asks with eyes that quietly wait for me alongside.

story.text: 결국 나는 요즘 마음속에 쌓아 뒀던 고민을 하나씩 털어놓기 시작했다. 선우는 끼어들지 않고 끝까지 들어준다.
story.reading: gyeol-guk na-neun yo-jeum ma-eum-sok-e ssa-a dwot-deon go-min-eul ha-na-ssik teol-eo-noh-gi si-jak-haet-da. seon-u-neun kki-eo-deul-ji anh-go kkeut-kka-ji deul-eo-jun-da.
story.en: In the end, I started unloading, one by one, the worries I'd been carrying inside. Sunwoo doesn't interrupt, and listens all the way through.

story.text: "고생했네, 니. 혼자 그거 다 짊어지고 있었나." 그의 목소리는 여느 때와 다르게 낮고 진지했다.
story.reading: go-saeng-haet-ne, ni. hon-ja geu-geo da jjim-eo-ji-go iss-eot-na. geu-ui mok-so-ri-neun yeo-neu ttae-wa da-reu-ge nat-go jin-ji-haet-da.
story.en: "You've had it rough. Were you carrying all that alone?" His voice was low and serious, unlike his usual self.

story.text: "말 안 해도 안다, 내가. 니 원래 힘든 티 잘 안 내는 거." 그가 내 어깨를 툭툭 두드리며 말을 잇는다.
story.reading: mal an hae-do an-da, nae-ga. ni won-lae him-deun ti jal an nae-neun geo. geu-ga nae eo-kkae-reul tuk-tuk du-deu-ri-myeo mal-eul it-neun-da.
story.en: "I know even without you saying it. You've always been bad at showing when you're struggling." He pats my shoulder and continues.

story.text: "근데 내한테는 좀 기대라. 우리 그런 사이 아이가." 담담하게 건네는 그 말에, 꾹 참았던 눈물이 결국 핑 돈다.
story.reading: geun-de nae-han-te-neun jom gi-dae-ra. u-ri geu-reon sa-i a-i-ga. dam-dam-ha-ge geon-ne-neun geu mal-e, kkuk cham-at-deon nun-mul-i gyeol-guk ping don-da.
story.en: "But you can lean on me a little. Isn't that what we are to each other." At those calmly spoken words, the tears I'd been holding back finally well up.

story.text: 선우는 별다른 위로의 말 대신, 그저 조용히 내 옆자리를 지켰다. 파도 소리만이 우리 사이를 채웠고, 그걸로 충분했다.
story.reading: seon-u-neun byeol-da-reun wi-ro-ui mal dae-sin, geu-jeo jo-yong-hi nae yeop-ja-ri-reul ji-kyeot-da. pa-do so-ri-man-i u-ri sa-i-reul chae-wot-go, geu-geol-lo chung-bun-haet-da.
story.en: Instead of any special words of comfort, Sunwoo simply, quietly held his seat beside me. Only the sound of waves filled the space between us, and that was enough.

words.example_en: His expression looked especially dark today.

words.meaning: to open up, confide, get something off one's chest
words.example_en: I opened up about my worries to my friend.

words.example: 혼자 그 짐을 다 짊어지고 있었다.
words.example_reading: hon-ja geu jim-eul da jjim-eo-ji-go iss-eot-da
words.example_en: I had been shouldering that whole burden alone.

words.meaning: to lean on, to rely on (someone)
words.example_en: When things are hard, you can lean on me.

words.example: 그의 말 한마디가 큰 위로가 됐다.
words.example_reading: geu-ui mal han-ma-di-ga keun wi-ro-ga dwaet-da
words.example_en: His single sentence became a great comfort.

sentences.en: I opened up to him about my worries.
You don't have to shoulder the burden alone.
When it's hard, you can lean on a friend.

sentences.ko: 그의 진심 어린 위로가 큰 힘이 됐다.
sentences.reading: geu-ui jin-sim eo-rin wi-ro-ga keun him-i dwaet-da
sentences.en: His sincere comfort became a great strength.

turns.speaker: 선우
turns.text: 니 아까부터 표정이 안 좋다. 무슨 일 있제?
turns.reading: ni a-kka-bu-teo pyo-jeong-i an jo-ta. mu-seun il it-je?
turns.en: You've had a bad look on your face for a while. Something's up, right?

turns.speaker: 승객
turns.text: 티가 그렇게 났어? 별거 아니야, 그냥 요즘 좀 복잡해서.
turns.reading: ti-ga geu-reoh-ge nat-eo? byeol-geo a-ni-ya, geu-nyang yo-jeum jom bok-jab-hae-seo.
turns.en: Was it that obvious? It's nothing much, just things have been complicated lately.

turns.speaker: 선우
turns.text: 별거 아니어도 된다, 얘기하고 싶으면 해라. 내는 그냥 들어줄 테니까.
turns.reading: byeol-geo a-ni-eo-do doen-da, yae-gi-ha-go sip-eu-myeon hae-ra. nae-neun geu-nyang deul-eo-jul te-ni-kka.
turns.en: It's fine even if it's nothing much, talk if you want to. I'll just listen.

turns.speaker: 승객
turns.text: 고마워. 사실 요즘 고민이 좀 있었어.
turns.reading: go-ma-wo. sa-sil yo-jeum go-min-i jom iss-eot-eo.
turns.en: Thanks. Actually, I've had some worries lately.

dialogues.question: 선우가 승객의 표정을 보고 취한 태도로 알맞은 것은?
dialogues.question_en: How did Sunwoo respond upon noticing the passenger's expression?
dialogues.correct_answer: 캐묻지 않고 편하게 이야기할 수 있도록 기다려 주었다
options: 캐묻지 않고 편하게 이야기할 수 있도록 기다려 주었다
dialogues.explanation: 선우는 재촉하지 않고, 승객이 편하게 이야기를 꺼낼 수 있도록 기다려 줍니다.

turns.speaker: 선우
turns.text: 고생했네, 니. 혼자 그거 다 짊어지고 있었나.
turns.reading: go-saeng-haet-ne, ni. hon-ja geu-geo da jjim-eo-ji-go iss-eot-na.
turns.en: You've had it rough. Were you carrying all that alone?

turns.speaker: 승객
turns.text: 괜히 걱정 끼치는 거 같아서 말 안 했었어.
turns.reading: gwaen-hi geok-jeong kki-chi-neun geo gat-a-seo mal an haet-eot-eo.
turns.en: I didn't say anything because I felt like it'd just worry you.

turns.speaker: 선우
turns.text: 말 안 해도 안다, 내가. 근데 내한테는 좀 기대라. 우리 그런 사이 아이가.
turns.reading: mal an hae-do an-da, nae-ga. geun-de nae-han-te-neun jom gi-dae-ra. u-ri geu-reon sa-i a-i-ga.
turns.en: I know even without you saying it. But you can lean on me a little. Isn't that what we are to each other.

turns.speaker: 승객
turns.en: Thanks, seriously. I'm glad you're here.

dialogues.question: 선우가 승객에게 전하고 싶었던 마음은 무엇인가요?
dialogues.question_en: What feeling was Sunwoo trying to convey to the passenger?
dialogues.correct_answer: 힘들 때 자신에게 기대도 된다는 것
options: 힘들 때 자신에게 기대도 된다는 것
dialogues.explanation: 선우는 승객이 혼자 짐을 짊어지지 않고 자신에게 기대도 된다는 진심을 전합니다.
